name: Syphc Medium (DSMZ J898)
description: DSMZ culture medium J898 (complex). Contains undefined components (Distilled water, H3BO3, HEPES, Sea Salt, Yeast extract) rendered as a labeled in-silico hydrolysate approximation. Defined compounds mapped to BiGG (g/L->mM via molar mass); salts dissociated to ion exchanges.

provenance.citation: MediaDive (Koblitz J et al., Nucleic Acids Res 2023), aggregating JCM medium 898: SYPHC MEDIUM.
provenance.notes: Presence-based uptake bounds; recipe_g_l + concentration_mM retained. Undefined hydrolysates approximated as amino acids + nucleosides + vitamins (labeled).
provenance.source_identity_evidence: provenance.doi == '10.1093/nar/gkac803' (MediaDive database paper) and citation contains 'MediaDive'
provenance.citation_original: DSMZ MediaDive (Koblitz J et al., Nucleic Acids Res 2023); DSMZ Medium J898: SYPHC MEDIUM.

attribution_conflict.note: The display name still says DSMZ. It is left unchanged here so this stage does not collide with the naming stage (range 50-59), which should apply suggested_name.

coverage_source.definition: pct_covered_all = components / (components + unresolved ingredients) — the legacy metric, which counts pipeline-derived components as covered. pct_covered_source = source-stated components / (those + unresolved ingredients + ingredients replaced by derived components).
